intro.en: A husband and wife talk about the weather outside. It is raining, it is autumn, and the coat and umbrella were left behind. Learn words like sky (السَّماء), rain (تُمْطِر) and warm (دافِئ).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke miyan biwi bahar ke mausam ke baare mein baat karte hain. Baarish ho rahi hai, khizaan ka mausam hai, aur coat aur chhatri peeche reh gaye. Naye alfaaz: aasmaan (السَّماء), baarish (تُمْطِر), gunguna (دافِئ).
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ زَوْجٌ وَزَوْجَتُهُ عَنِ الجَوِّ في الخارِج: المَطَرُ يَنْزِل، وَالفَصْلُ خَريف، وَنَسِيا المِعْطَفَ وَالمِظَلَّة. نَتَعَلَّمُ: السَّماء، تُمْطِر، دافِئ.

dialogue.en: How is the weather outside?
dialogue.ur: Bahar mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّماءُ تُمْطِرُ الآنَ؛ هذا فَصْلُ الخَريفِ.
dialogue.tr: as-samāʾu tumṭiru l-āna; hādhā faṣlu l-kharīf
dialogue.en: The sky is raining now; this is the autumn season.
dialogue.ur: Abhi baarish ho rahi hai; yeh khizaan ka mausam hai.

dialogue.en: Your clothes are wet. Where is the coat?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke kapde bheeg gaye hain. Coat kahan hai?

dialogue.en: I left it at the company.
dialogue.ur: Maine usay daftar (company) mein chhor diya.

dialogue.en: And where is the umbrella?
dialogue.ur: Aur chhatri kahan hai?

dialogue.en: I left it in the car.
dialogue.ur: Maine usay gaari mein chhor diya.

dialogue.en: Drink this warm tea.
dialogue.ur: Yeh gunguna chai pee lein.

dialogue.en: May Allah bless you.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko barkat de.

dialogue.en: Shall we go to the market now?
dialogue.ur: Kya hum abhi bazaar jayein?

dialogue.en: There is very much water outside.
dialogue.ur: Bahar bahut zyada paani hai.

dialogue.en: What shall we do?
dialogue.ur: Hum kya karein?

dialogue.en: We will stay at home tonight.
dialogue.ur: Hum aaj raat ghar mein rahenge.

dialogue.ar: وَنَذْهَبُ غَداً إِلى السّوقِ، إِنْ شاءَ اللَّهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa nadhhabu ghadan ilā s-sūq, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: And we will go to the market tomorrow, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum kal bazaar jayenge, in sha Allah.

dialogue.en: This is a good idea.
dialogue.ur: Yeh achha khayal hai.

q.en: Which season is it in Dialogue 1?
q.ur: Mukaalma 1 mein kaun sa mausam hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ فَصْلٍ هُمْ في الحِوارِ الأَوَّل؟

q.en: Where did the husband leave the umbrella (المِظَلَّة)?
q.ur: Shohar ne chhatri (المِظَلَّة) kahan chhori?

q.en: What does تُمْطِرُ mean?
q.ur: تُمْطِرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: When will they go to the market?
q.ur: Woh bazaar kab jayenge?

q.en: What does هذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ mean?
q.ur: هذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ ka kya matlab hai?

title.en: Dialogue 2: A phone call about the weather
title.ur: Mukaalma 2: Phone par mausam ki baat

intro.en: Hassan calls Badr from London. They talk about cold and hot weather and the temperature. Learn hot (حارّ), cold (بارِد), moderate (مُعْتَدِل) and below zero (تَحْتَ الصِّفْر).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Hassan London se Badr ko phone karta hai. Dono mausam, sardi garmi aur darja-e-hararat ki baat karte hain. Naye alfaaz: garm (حارّ), thanda (بارِد), mo'tadil (مُعْتَدِل), sifar se neeche (تَحْتَ الصِّفْر).
intro.ar: يَتَّصِلُ حَسَنٌ بِبَدْرٍ مِنْ لَنْدَن، وَيَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ الجَوِّ البارِدِ وَالحارِّ وَدَرَجَةِ الحَرارَة. نَتَعَلَّمُ: حارّ، بارِد، مُعْتَدِل، تَحْتَ الصِّفْر.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم يا بَدْرُ. أَنا حَسّانُ، أَتَكَلَّمُ مِنْ لَنْدَن.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum yā Badr. anā Ḥassān, atakallamu min Landan
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, Badr. I am Hassan, I am speaking from London.
dialogue.ur: Assalam o alaikum Badr. Main Hassan hoon, London se baat kar raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ يا حَسّانُ. كَيْفَ الجَوُّ في لَنْدَن؟
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salām yā Ḥassān. kayfa l-jawwu fī Landan?
dialogue.en: And upon you peace, Hassan. How is the weather in London?
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam Hassan. London mein mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوُّ بارِدٌ في لَنْدَن. هذا فَصْلُ الشِّتاءِ.
dialogue.tr: al-jawwu bāridun fī Landan. hādhā faṣlu sh-shitāʾ
dialogue.en: The weather is cold in London. This is the winter season.
dialogue.ur: London mein mausam thanda hai. Yeh sardiyon ka mausam hai.

dialogue.en: What is the temperature in London?
dialogue.ur: London mein darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ. كَيْفَ الجَوُّ في الرِّياضِ؟
dialogue.tr: taḥta ṣ-ṣifr. kayfa l-jawwu fī r-Riyāḍ?
dialogue.en: Below zero. How is the weather in Riyadh?
dialogue.ur: Sifar se neeche. Riyadh mein mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.ar: كانَ الجَوُّ حارّاً، وَهُوَ الآنَ مُعْتَدِلٌ.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-jawwu ḥārran, wa huwa l-āna muʿtadil
dialogue.en: The weather was hot, and it is now moderate.
dialogue.ur: Mausam garm tha, aur ab mo'tadil hai.

dialogue.en: What is the temperature in Riyadh?
dialogue.ur: Riyadh mein darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.en: The temperature is twenty.
dialogue.ur: Darja-e-hararat bees hai.

dialogue.en: Will you spend the holiday in London?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap chhutti London mein guzarenge?

dialogue.ar: لا، سَأَقْضيها في تونُسَ، إِنْ شاءَ اللَّهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā, sa-aqḍīhā fī Tūnus, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: No, I will spend it in Tunisia, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, main usay Tunisia mein guzaroonga, in sha Allah.

vocab.ur: mo'tadil, na zyada garm na thanda

q.en: How is the weather in London in Dialogue 2?
q.ur: Mukaalma 2 mein London ka mausam kaisa hai?
q.ar: كَيْفَ الجَوُّ في لَنْدَنَ في الحِوارِ الثّاني؟

q.en: What does تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ mean?
q.ur: تَحْتَ الصِّفْرِ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What is the temperature in Riyadh?
q.ur: Riyadh mein darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

q.en: Where will Badr spend his holiday?
q.ur: Badr apni chhutti kahan guzarega?

q.en: What does مُعْتَدِلٌ mean?
q.ur: مُعْتَدِلٌ ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mukaalma 3: Hafte ki chhutti ka plan

intro.en: Khalid and Hazim plan their weekend. It is spring, so the weather is mild. They decide to go to the desert and bring a tent and a carpet. Learn summer (الصَّيْف), spring (الرَّبيع), tent (خَيْمَة) and beach (شاطِئ).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Khalid aur Hazim apni hafte ki chhutti ka plan banate hain. Bahar ka mausam hai, mausam mo'tadil hai. Woh registan (barr) jaane ka faisla karte hain aur khaima aur qaleen layenge. Naye alfaaz: garmiyon (الصَّيْف), bahar (الرَّبيع), khaima (خَيْمَة), saahil (شاطِئ).
intro.ar: يُخَطِّطُ خالِدٌ وَحازِمٌ لِعُطْلَةِ الأُسْبوع. الفَصْلُ رَبيعٌ وَالجَوُّ مُعْتَدِل، فَيُقَرِّرانِ الذَّهابَ إِلى البَرِّ وَحَمْلَ خَيْمَةٍ وَسَجّادَة. نَتَعَلَّمُ: الصَّيْف، الرَّبيع، خَيْمَة، شاطِئ.

dialogue.en: The weather is moderate these days.
dialogue.ur: In dinon mausam mo'tadil hai.

dialogue.en: This is the spring season.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bahar ka mausam hai.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ذَهَبَ الصَّيْفُ، وَذَهَبَ الحَرُّ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh, dhahaba ṣ-ṣayf, wa dhahaba l-ḥarr
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, the summer has gone, and the heat has gone.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, garmi ka mausam chala gaya aur garmi bhi chali gayi.

dialogue.tr: wa dhahaba sh-shitāʾ, wa dhahaba l-bard
dialogue.en: And the winter has gone, and the cold has gone.
dialogue.ur: Aur sardi ka mausam chala gaya aur thand bhi chali gayi.

dialogue.en: Where shall we spend the weekend holiday?
dialogue.ur: Hum hafte ki chhutti kahan guzarein?

dialogue.en: We will go to the beach.
dialogue.ur: Hum saahil par jayenge.

dialogue.en: The beach is far, we will go to the desert.
dialogue.ur: Saahil door hai, hum registan (barr) jayenge.

dialogue.ar: هذِهِ فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ، نَذْهَبُ إِلى البَرِّ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi fikra ṭayyiba, nadhhabu ilā l-barr
dialogue.en: This is a good idea, we will go to the desert.
dialogue.ur: Yeh achha khayal hai, hum registan chalte hain.

dialogue.en: I will bring the tent and the carpet.
dialogue.ur: Main khaima aur qaleen laaonga.

dialogue.en: I will bring the food and the drink.
dialogue.ur: Main khana aur peene ki cheezein laaonga.

dialogue.en: My family will come with me.
dialogue.ur: Meri family mere saath aayegi.

dialogue.en: My family will come with me too.
dialogue.ur: Meri family bhi mere saath aayegi.

vocab.ur: woh haazir hota hai, aata hai

q.en: Which season is it in Dialogue 3?
q.ur: Mukaalma 3 mein kaun sa mausam hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ فَصْلٍ هُمْ في الحِوارِ الثّالِث؟

q.en: Where do Khalid and Hazim decide to go?
q.ur: Khalid aur Hazim kahan jaane ka faisla karte hain?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ يُقَرِّرُ خالِدٌ وَحازِمٌ أَنْ يَذْهَبا؟

q.en: Why do they not go to the beach?
q.ur: Woh saahil par kyun nahin jaate?

q.en: What will Khalid bring?
q.ur: Khalid kya le kar aayega?

q.en: What does خَيْمَةٌ mean?
q.ur: خَيْمَةٌ ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mausam, waqt aur jagah ke alfaaz

intro.en: This lesson has extra words. Learn the words for place (in, above, under, in front of, behind, right, left) and for time (year, month, week, day). Practice naming the four seasons too.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum jagah batane wale alfaaz seekhenge (andar, upar, neeche, aage, peeche, daayen, baayen) aur waqt ke alfaaz (saal, mahina, hafta, din). Chaaron mausamon ke naam bhi yaad karenge.
intro.ar: كَلِماتٌ إِضافِيَّة: كَلِماتُ المَكانِ (في، فَوْقَ، تَحْتَ، أَمامَ، خَلْفَ، يَمين، شِمال) وَكَلِماتُ الزَّمَنِ (سَنَة، شَهْر، أُسْبوع، يَوْم). نُسَمّي أَيْضاً الفُصولَ الأَرْبَعَة.

q.en: What does تَحْتَ mean?
q.ur: تَحْتَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "behind"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "peeche" ka matlab deta hai?

q.en: Which is the longest period of time?
q.ur: In mein sab se lamba waqt kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على أَطْوَلِ مُدَّةٍ مِنَ الزَّمَن؟

q.en: What does أُسْبوعٌ mean?
q.ur: أُسْبوعٌ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "to the right of"?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "daayen taraf" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على جِهَةِ اليَمين؟

title.en: Grammar patterns: I will bring, I left it, how much

intro.en: Learn useful sentence patterns. سَـ before a verb means "will" (سَأُحْضِرُ = I will bring). تَرَكْتُهُ / تَرَكْتُها = "I left it" (-hu for masculine, -hā for feminine). كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ؟ = What is the temperature?
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum jumlay banane ke aham tareeqay seekhenge. Fe'l se pehle سَـ ka matlab "gaa/gi" hai (سَأُحْضِرُ = main laaonga). تَرَكْتُهُ / تَرَكْتُها = "maine usay chhor diya" (muzakkar ke liye -hu, muannas ke liye -hā). كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَةِ؟ = Darja-e-hararat kitna hai?
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ تَراكيبَ مُفيدَة. السّينُ قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ تَدُلُّ على المُسْتَقْبَل (سَأُحْضِرُ). وَنَقولُ تَرَكْتُهُ لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَتَرَكْتُها لِلْمُؤَنَّث. وَنَسْأَلُ: كَمْ دَرَجَةُ الحَرارَة؟

vocab.en: I left it (m.) at the company
I left it (f.) in the car
what is the temperature in Riyadh?

q.en: What does سَأُحْضِرُ mean?
q.ur: سَأُحْضِرُ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which sentence asks about the temperature?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla darja-e-hararat poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ دَرَجَةِ الحَرارَة؟

q.en: Which fits: "The umbrella (feminine) — I left ___ in the car"?
q.ur: Kaun sa theek hai: "Chhatri (muannas) — maine ___ gaari mein chhori"?

q.en: What does هَلْ نَذْهَبُ إِلى السّوقِ الآنَ؟ mean?
q.ur: هَلْ نَذْهَبُ إِلى السّوقِ الآنَ؟ ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَسْأَلُ بِجُمْلَةِ «هَلْ نَذْهَبُ إِلى السّوقِ الآنَ؟»

options: Shall we go to the market now?
options_ar: نَسْأَلُ هَلْ نَسيرُ إِلى السّوقِ في هذا الوَقْت

title.en: Sounds and listening: ض and ظ
title.ur: Aawazein aur sunna: ض aur ظ

intro.en: Listen and repeat two similar letters: ض (Dād) and ظ (Zā'). ض is made with the side of the tongue, ظ with the tip between the teeth. Then listen to a few short passages and answer questions.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum do milte julte huroof ض (Dād) aur ظ (Zā) ko sun kar dohrayenge. ض zaban ke kinare se aur ظ zaban ki nok daanton ke beech rakh kar bola jata hai. Phir chhoti chhoti baatein sun kar sawalon ke jawab denge.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ وَنُكَرِّرُ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَشابِهَيْن: الضّادَ وَالظّاء. تَخْرُجُ الضّادُ مِنْ جانِبِ اللِّسان، وَالظّاءُ مِنْ طَرَفِهِ بَيْنَ الأَسْنان. ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى فِقَراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ وَنُجيبُ.

q.en: Which letter is in the word فَضْلٌ?
q.ur: فَضْلٌ lafz mein kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: Which letter is in the word ظَهيرٌ?
q.ur: ظَهيرٌ lafz mein kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: Which word contains ض?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein ض hai?

q.en: Which word contains ظ?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein ظ hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a friend using the examples. Ask about the weather and temperature in a city, where to spend the holiday, and what to do tonight.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum dost ke saath misaalon ki tarah sawal jawab ki mashq karenge. Kisi shehar ka mausam aur darja-e-hararat poochna, chhutti kahan guzarni hai, aur aaj raat kya karna hai.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ مَعَ صَديقٍ على السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ بِالأَمْثِلَة: نَسْأَلُ عَنِ الجَوِّ وَدَرَجَةِ الحَرارَةِ في مَدينَة، وَأَيْنَ نَقْضي الإِجازَة، وَماذا نَفْعَلُ اللَّيْلَة.

dialogue.en: How is the weather in London?
dialogue.ur: London mein mausam kaisa hai?

dialogue.en: The weather is very cold in London.
dialogue.ur: London mein mausam bahut thanda hai.

dialogue.en: What is the temperature now?
dialogue.ur: Abhi darja-e-hararat kitna hai?

dialogue.en: The temperature now is five.
dialogue.ur: Abhi darja-e-hararat paanch hai.

dialogue.en: Will you spend the holiday in London?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap chhutti London mein guzarenge?

dialogue.en: No, I will spend it in Tunisia.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, main usay Tunisia mein guzaroonga.

dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.ur: Kyun?

dialogue.ar: الجَوُّ بارِدٌ في لَنْدَن، وَمُعْتَدِلٌ في تونُسَ.
dialogue.tr: al-jawwu bāridun fī Landan, wa muʿtadilun fī Tūnus
dialogue.en: The weather is cold in London, and moderate in Tunisia.
dialogue.ur: London mein mausam thanda hai aur Tunisia mein mo'tadil hai.

dialogue.en: Where will we spend the weekend?
dialogue.ur: Hum hafte ki chhutti kahan guzarenge?

dialogue.en: We will go to Amman.
dialogue.ur: Hum Amman jayenge.

dialogue.en: Amman is far. Let us go to Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Amman door hai. Hum Makkah chalte hain.

dialogue.en: A good idea. We will go to Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Achha khayal hai. Hum Makkah chalte hain.

q.en: What does لِماذا؟ mean?
q.ur: لِماذا؟ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What does جِدّاً mean?
q.ur: جِدّاً ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How do you ask "What is the temperature now?"
q.ur: "Abhi darja-e-hararat kitna hai?" kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ نَسْأَلُ عَنْ دَرَجَةِ الحَرارَةِ الآن؟

q.en: Which is the sentence "Amman is far"?
q.ur: "Amman door hai" kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُ إِنَّ عَمّانَ بَعيدَة؟

intro.en: Read four short passages about the seasons: spring with Hazim, autumn with Ibrahim, summer with Malik, and winter with Salih. Then answer the questions about each.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mausamon par chaar chhote paragraph parhenge: bahar (Hazim), khizaan (Ibrahim), garmi (Malik) aur sardi (Salih). Phir har paragraph ke sawalon ke jawab denge.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ أَرْبَعَ فِقَراتٍ عَنِ الفُصول: الرَّبيعُ مَعَ حازِم، وَالخَريفُ مَعَ إِبْراهيم، وَالصَّيْفُ مَعَ مالِك، وَالشِّتاءُ مَعَ صالِح. ثُمَّ نُجيبُ عَنْ كُلِّ فِقْرَة.

q.en: In the first passage, what does Hazim read in the tent?
q.ur: Pehle paragraph mein Hazim khaime mein kya parhta hai?

intro.en: Join letters to make words, arrange letters, match word pairs to make phrases and put words in order to make sentences. Also learn six colours: blue, red, black, green, white and yellow.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum huroof jodkar alfaaz banayenge, huroof ko tarteeb denge, do alfaaz milakar tarkeeb banayenge aur alfaaz ko tarteeb dekar jumlay banayenge. Saath hi chhe rang seekhenge: neela, laal, kaala, hara, safaid aur peela.
intro.ar: نَصِلُ الحُروفَ لِنُكَوِّنَ كَلِمات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الحُروف، وَنَصِلُ كَلِماتٍ لِنُكَوِّنَ عِبارات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الكَلِماتِ لِنَكْتُبَ جُمَلاً. وَنَتَعَلَّمُ سِتَّةَ أَلْوان: الأَزْرَق، الأَحْمَر، الأَسْوَد، الأَخْضَر، الأَبْيَض، الأَصْفَر.

intro.en: A review test of words and sentences from earlier units. Try the exercises, then check yourself with the answer pages.
intro.ur: Pichhle units ke alfaaz aur jumlon ka dohraai test. Mashqein karein, phir jawab wale safhon se apna kaam check karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ لِكَلِماتٍ وَجُمَلٍ مِنَ الوَحَداتِ السّابِقَة. نَحُلُّ التَّمارينَ ثُمَّ نُصَحِّحُ بِأَنْفُسِنا.
